import json,sys,ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
from reference import version_frontier, brute_case, reference_runs
from protocol import parse_request
payload=json.load(open('/tmp/case2.json'))
req=parse_request(json.dumps({'cases':[payload]}).encode())
case=req[0]
hit,miss,dec=case['costs']
print('costs',hit,miss,dec,'C',case['cache_pages'])
fib={}
for route,hop in case['initial']: fib[route]=hop
hists=[dict(fib)]
for tx in case['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    hists.append(dict(fib))
fronts=[];fixed_list=[]
for vi,versions_v in enumerate(hists):
    starts,hops=reference_runs(versions_v)
    bl=[(repeat,[int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)) for a in addresses]) for v_,repeat,addresses in case['bursts'] if v_==vi]
    fr=version_frontier(starts,hops,bl,case['cache_pages'],hit,miss,dec)
    fr.sort()
    print('v',vi,'R',len(starts),'frontier',fr)
    fronts.append(fr); fixed_list.append(1+(len(starts)*4+63)//64)
print('fixed',fixed_list)
print('brute_case',brute_case(fronts,case['cache_pages'],hit,miss,dec,fixed_list))
